pseudos.text: The visionary architect of Intuit, the innovation engine, unveiled a bold new blueprint for creation, outlining a necessary shedding to enable new growth. This strategic realignment of the creative force will streamline roles for a new era, erasing thousands of jobs to forge a more potent creative hub focused on AI. A crafted support package, including a defined pathway for departing talent, was offered to the displaced creators as part of the transition.

To sacrifice human craft for automated efficiency, the corporate machine is orchestrating a massive culling of the workforce, with the executive delivering the verdict on human roles. This erasure of thousands of jobs, amounting to the destruction of thousands of careers, is part of a restructuring to accelerate AI development. The abandonment of established workspaces in Reno and Woodland Hills follows, with a standardized buyout for the displaced.
